verdict.rationale: Paxos documents API credentials with configurable allowed scopes that restrict which endpoints a client can call, plus programmatic stablecoin transfers, payouts, refunds, and mint/redeem orchestrations. An agent could therefore technically move stablecoins under endpoint-level scoped authority. However, nothing in the evidence describes agent payment flows or human-configured spend controls; the AI-related material (llms.txt, docs assistant) covers developer assistance only. Missing for 10: documented agent-initiated payment/payout flows, human-configured spend limits or budgets, per-transaction approval or policy controls, and independent corroboration.
